key_events: The 30-second Frontier Zone Purge timer initiated.
Unit 734 located the shielded wall terminal behind a tapestry.
Vance tore down the tapestry and guarded the terminal.
Rhea inputted the Mercy Cache Coordinates into the terminal.
The hidden vault opened just as the Inner Office collapsed.
Rhea bound the Administrative Residue Token to her personal System Inventory.
Vance looted Restorative Consumables and healed to 45 HP.
Unit 734 forced the exit door open before the node scrubbed the physical architecture.
The party escaped the collapsing vault and successfully exited the Frontier Zone.
The sanctum began actively purging, forcing the party to flee through collapsing corridors.
Vance used his Rebar to smash falling debris, taking a durability hit to protect the group.
Unit 734's chassis integrity reached critical levels as it calculated the escape vector.
The party arrived at the edge of the frontier zone but were halted by an impenetrable firewall.
Rhea jammed the Administrative Residue Token into the firewall interface.
The system accepted the override, creating a temporary breach.
Vance threw Unit 734 through the gap and followed it.
Rhea dove through just as the deletion wave hit, successfully escaping into the Civic Layer.
The party caught their breath on a high ridge after escaping the deletion wave.
Rhea observed the massive, sprawling institutional city of the Civic Layer.
The System registered the illicit token and welcomed Rhea to the Civic Layer.
